Køge is a Danish municipality that appears in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates clinical quality in the treatment of atrial fibrillation across all 98 Danish municipalities, utilizing data from the Danish National Patient Register (LPR) and the Danish Stroke Register (DanStroke) to benchmark local healthcare performance [^src1].

Within this corpus, Køge is mentioned exclusively as a geographic data point for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. Specifically, the municipality's statistical outcomes are listed in the report's detailed municipal breakdown, recording 7 out of 1,444 cases with a 0% rate and a metric of 0.5 (0.2-1.0), alongside 8 out of 1,400 cases with a 0.6% rate and a metric of 1.0 [^src1]. No further historical, relational, or operational details about the municipality are provided in the source document.
